```{webr}
#| autorun: true
# SHARED EXAMPLE TABLE for the dplyr lessons — include it with:
#     {{< include _example-data.qmd >}}
# Five rows, two trips, using the real column names from the user's data so that what the learner
# practises here transfers unchanged to their own records. Lessons that teach a dplyr verb should share
# this table rather than declaring their own, so the same five rows carry across the course.
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))

example <- data.frame(
  trip_id      = c("trip_1", "trip_1", "trip_1", "trip_2", "trip_2"),
  landing_date = c("2024-01-05", "2024-01-05", "2024-01-05", "2024-01-06", "2024-01-06"),
  gaul_2_name  = c("Shimoni", "Shimoni", "Shimoni", "Vanga", "Vanga"),
  gear         = c("hand line", "hand line", "hand line", "gillnet", "gillnet"),
  catch_taxon  = c("Tilapia", "Snapper", "Octopus", "Tilapia", "Snapper"),
  catch_kg     = c(12, 5, 3, 8, 6)
)
example
```
